page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top to bottom: large title block centred (EXAMEN / BVLLAE PAPALIS, / QVA / P. INNOCENTIUS X. / Abrogare nititur Pacem Germaniae: / INSTITUTUM / A / JOHANNE HOORNBEECK / S. Litterarum in Ecclesia, & Academia / Ultrajectina Doctore.), then an engraving of a tree with a banner, then the imprint lines (ULTRAJECTI, / Ex Officina Johannis à Waesberge / Anno clɔIɔCLII). Library stamp and handwritten mark on the page are not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraving: a tree with spreading foliage, a banner reading "EX FLORE FRUCTUS" (partly legible), and a standing figure with a staff at right; not transcribed as text. Library stamps ("BIBLIOTECA NAZ ROMA VITTORIO EMANUELE") and a handwritten mark at top right are excluded. The date line is set in old-style numerals; read as MDCLII (1652) with uncertainty on the reversed-C forms. Imprint line "Anno" date rendered as printed.
